aspect_oracle.drift_guard: Smoke re-reads the generated file's MediaBox (or the generator's exported page-size constant) and fails loudly if it is not [0, 0, 612, 792].
aspect_oracle.task_2_note: No edit needed — the page size is already implemented and citable.

interception.scope: page.route() matches only the generated fixture's /api/doc-asset URL; nothing else intercepted
interception.byte_source: fixture bytes read in the smoke process (Bun.file(largePdfPath).arrayBuffer())

rangeless_first_request.behavior: fulfil only the first canonical chunk (64 KiB, clamped to file size) as 206 with correct range headers
rangeless_first_request.purpose: keep subsequent PDF.js Range requests observable

queue_controls.behavior: later Range requests are queued and their route objects held, not fulfilled
queue_controls.wait_mechanism: page.waitForFunction / request promises under the harness's ordinary assertion timeout

release_policy.until: at least one page node reports data-rendered="true" (first paint)
release_policy.granularity: one queued range at a time

held_later_range.requirement: >= 1 later Range request queued and still held
held_later_range.if_not_requested: programmatically scroll [data-testid="pdf-page-column"] to bring a later pending page into the IntersectionObserver window, then await nextQueuedRange() and keep it held
held_later_range.constraint: the scroll must keep the first painted page inside the live window so it is not evicted and first paint stays valid

evidence: request/control log: intercepted URLs, per-request Range header, fulfilled-vs-held disposition, release order, queue depth over time
resolution.teardown: all held routes released and unrouted in a finally block so teardown cannot hang
resolution.evidence_scope_statement: Synthetic interception evidence for the progressive rendering contract only; proves nothing about network timing, streaming performance, or the zero-non-self posture, which come exclusively from the clean non-intercepted run.
